name: Royal Mud Treatment

start.dialog: Oink! My mud bath! Need special minerals! Three kinds - black, green, and gold! From different Mire pools! Bring them? I give you mud treatment too! Good for skin! Oink!
start.objective: Collect black, green, and gold mud from three different Mire pools

progress.dialog: Missing some mud! Need all three colors! For PERFECT mud bath! Oink!
progress.objective: Find the remaining special mud locations

complete.dialog: Perfect mud! Look at this consistency! This temperature! You try! *splashes mud* Feel that? REJUVENATING! Here - mud treatment voucher! Anytime!

party_comments.twist: Mud! I love mud! Let's all jump in!
party_comments.nix7: Mineral content: therapeutic. Social acceptability: questionable.

hidden_outcome: If you bring rare 'Rainbow Mud' from a hidden pool, Pigman gives you 'Mire Blessing' - permanent poison resistance
